name: Summit AZ - Performance Report 2026-09-23
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-23

# Summary
13-page plain-English client report, "More people clicked. Fewer people saw us." Compares June 1 to 30 with Aug 24 to Sep 22 2026 (30 days each). HTML sources: `dashboard.html`, `dashboard-technical-backup.html` and `case-study.html` in the same folder.

# Key numbers
- Clicks 28 to 38 (+36%); impressions 17,800 to 11,400 (-36%); CTR 0.2% to 0.3%; average position 28 to 27 (page 3).
- Moved up: Mesa sewer line repair 40 to 18, Queen Creek plumbing 49 to 26, San Tan Valley 43 to 25, slab leaks 47 to 30, Phoenix pipe lining 42 to 25, /plumbing/ 24 to 9, Fountain Hills drain cleaning new at 9.
- Moved down: homepage 17 to 24 (about two thirds of all clicks come from it), plumber near me 15 to 24, emergency plumber tempe 21 to 33; three local queries dropped out.
- 55 of 127 clicks were brand searches. 17 pages hold half the impressions and earned 2 clicks. Some impressions are other places named Summit or Mesa (Indiana, Louisiana, Costa Mesa) and can never convert.

# Recommended fixes
- Quick wins: find what takes the click on the Tempe water softener and slab leak pages; give "emergency plumber tempe" a proper page (2,495 impressions, 0 clicks, wrong page ranking); explain the homepage slip to Scott (homepage is off limits under the current agreement).
- Bigger: decide on pages stuck on page 3 to 6; confirm what counts as a lead in GA4 (rotating GHL numbers); always take a before measurement.

# Caveats in the report
- The new site was built from a copy of the Utah site and its GA connection came along: Arizona data went to the Utah GA account from Sep 3 to Sep 10; Scott reconnected it Sep 12.
- No pre-deploy speed baseline for the Sep 16 image and script work. September is a transition month (relaunch Sep 3, 86 new pages Sep 2).
